name: Iowan intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

i1.say: Howdy, stranger! Welcome to Iowan — best storm corn in four hundred moons, and don't let Venus tell you otherwise.

options.label: Business
options.text: I'm tracking the freighters that ride the flare wakes.

i3.say: Freighters, eh? Pour Lords on Ganymede run all the fuel out here — start with their ledgers. The Europapas folk have seen things under the ice, too. And the eggheads up Ursa Major chart every wake in the sky. Pick your moon, stranger.

do.code: if (root.Save.Quest.Stage == QuestStage.arrival || root.Save.Quest.Stage == QuestStage.followTheWakes) { root.Save.Quest.Stage = QuestStage.threePaths; }

i5.say: Take an ear of storm corn for the road. It hums when a flare's coming. Don't ask us why — we just farm here.

i2.say: Cloud-vat corn, sweetened by lightning! Was, anyway. The flare radiation's been cooking the crop bone-white. First season we've ever lost.
